messages.subject: SEM-warnings - HELP!
parts:
Hi there,
I got problems performing a SEM  I would be really glad If someone could give me a hint of what I´m doing wrong.

1) I proposed the following model

MyModel1 <- ' 
# Regressions (structural model)
y1 ~ b1*y2 + b2*y3 + b3*y4 + b4*y5

# Latent Variable Definition (measurement model)
y1 =~ x1 + x2
y2 =~ x3 + x4 + x5
y3 =~ x6 + x7
y4 =~ x8
y5 =~ x9
'
(y1 is my endogenous/dependent latent variable,
y2-y5 are my exogenous/independent/predictor variables
x1-x9 are my indicator variables)


2) 
In order to get the model fit and parameter estimates, I use ("mlr" because my data is not normally distributed)
fit_Model1 <- sem(MyModel1, data=filledin_missing, estimator = "mlr", fixed.x=FALSE)
summary(fit_Model3, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

I always get the following warnings - no matter what I change in my model-formula:
"1: In lav_object_post_check(lavobject) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated variances are negative
2: In lav_object_post_check(lavobject) :
  lavaan WARNING: observed variable error term matrix (theta) is not positive definite; use inspect(fit,"theta") to investigate."

Maybe the following information could be useful for you too:
--> x1-x9 are scores from different questionnaires and have different scales (but more or less similar)
--> none of x1-x9 is normally distributed
--> but: the residuals of x1 and x2 are normally distributed (which is the condition of SEM, right?!)
--> as i recently found out: all variables in my original dataset are "int". The variables listed above are basically the means of sets of original variables, but classified as "num"...


WHAT I ALREDAY TRIED (and what didnt work out better):

1) I also tried to add so fixed covariances to my model --> same warnings
      y4 ~~ 1*y4
      y5 ~~ 1*y5

2) I left out the part  --> same warnings
"y4 =~ x8
y5 =~ x9"

3) I tried to first do an CFA with my latent variable definitions  --> same warnings
# Latent Variable Definition (measurement model)
y1 =~ x1 + x2
y2 =~ x3 + x4 + x5
y3 =~ x6 + x7
y4 =~ x8
y5 =~ x9
'

parts:
The warning message is giving you a hint.  Did you inspect the theta matrix (residual covariance matrix of observed variables) to see which residual variance was negative?
